subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.**

The leader of the Legislative Assembly won the hearts of the members through his __maiden speech__ during the session in state council.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"maiden"** means:

 
 
• English Meaning: First (पहला)
 
• Hindi Meaning: पहला
 
 
 
• **Example:** The young athlete's maiden race was a remarkable success.
 
• **"First speech"** refers to the initial speech made by someone, usually in a formal setting.
 
 
• Hindi Meaning: पहला भाषण
 
 
 
• **Example:** The new CEO's first speech set a positive tone for the company's future.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Final speech** (अंतिम भाषण): The last speech given in a sequence of speeches.

 
 
• **Example:** His final speech as the president was very emotional.
 
 
 
• **Closure speech** (समापन भाषण): A speech given to conclude an event.
 
 
• **Example:** The closure speech at the conference summarized the key points discussed.
 
 
 
• **Logical speech** (तार्किक भाषण): A speech that is coherent and well-reasoned.
 
 
• **Example:** His logical speech persuaded many to support the new policy.
 
 

31:Tc59,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
